overview.title: Cloud administration
overview.description: Registered accounts and workspace resources. Current means not deleted; these counts do not measure recent activity.
overview.configurationDescription: These values are deployment-managed and read-only here. Change them through the production configuration and rollout workflow.
overview.securityDescription: This console exposes account and usage metadata only. Staff roles do not grant workspace membership, customer test data access, or hidden impersonation.

users.title: Users
users.description: Identity status and aggregate account relationships. Passwords and session secrets are never exposed.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.description: Find workspaces by name, slug or owner email, then inspect their contacts and aggregate usage.

billingAccounts.title: Billing accounts
billingAccounts.description: Commercial groupings above workspaces. Billing membership never grants workspace access.
billingAccounts.empty: No billing accounts match this search.

directory.searchError: Enter between 2 and 100 characters, or clear the search.
directory.invalidUrl: The link contains invalid filters or pagination. Reset the filters to continue.

operators.title: Staff operators
operators.description: Grant short-lived operational access to an existing verified Caselog identity.
operators.grantDescription: Access expires automatically after at most 90 days. Every change requires a reason and is audited.
operators.listDescription: Revocation takes effect on the next request.

audit.title: Staff audit
audit.description: Append-only history of privileged operator lifecycle changes.
audit.empty: No staff audit events match these filters.
audit.rangeHint: All event times and date filters use UTC. From is included; Until is excluded.
audit.invalidFilters: Check the filter values and use a valid UTC range with Until later than From.

workspace.title: Workspace details
workspace.loading: Reading workspace contacts and aggregate usage…
workspace.notFound: This workspace no longer exists. Return to the directory to find another workspace.
workspace.offline: Unable to connect. Check your connection and try again.
workspace.observedAt: Snapshot from {{date}}. Refresh to read current values.
workspace.usageDescription: Cases and runs exclude deleted records and archived projects. Open runs have active status. Ingestion attempts include successful and failed imports across retained history. Pending uploads are unexpired, incomplete reservations. Accounted storage follows storage reconciliation; reserved bytes are shown separately. These values do not measure recent human activity or represent quotas.

user.loading: Reading user identity and workspace memberships…
user.notFound: This user no longer exists. Return to the directory to find another user.
user.description: Current memberships, including retained relationships with deleted workspaces. Removed memberships are excluded. Staff access does not grant membership or customer content access.
user.empty: This user has no current workspace memberships.
